integrity: The proof is internal and finite-field checks are corroborative only; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the two known first non-thin valuation strata in k[t]/(t^14) are classified; no assertion about all truncated polynomial subalgebras.
The source 2018 first proved the truncation and embedded enumeration; novelty here is intrinsic isomorphism type, monomiality obstruction, and automorphism schemes.
Potential equivalent results in unlocated local-algebra classification papers have not been eliminated by a systematic census.
title: Thinness versus monomiality at the first truncated-polynomial non-thin strata
